headline: The stories behind India's leaders.
intro: CIO Mogul India is a digital magazine and broadcast platform.
whoWeAre: Through magazine features, interviews and broadcasts, we tell the stories of CIOs, entrepreneurs, startup founders, healthcare leaders and industry pioneers who are driving change across sectors.
We share thought leadership, innovation, digital transformation journeys and practical business insights from across India.
Our aim is simple: build a strong community of leaders, decision-makers and change-makers, and give a voice to the people and organisations shaping what comes next.
coverIntro: Three formats, one purpose: telling the stories of the people shaping India's business and technology.
